svg.title: Horsepasture temperature: original observations and sampling coverage
svg.desc: Original station 21NC03WQ-H6000000, 106 water-temperature records. Markers distinguish reported analytical methods; open markers carry an original coded qualification. The dashed 20°C reference is the trout-temperature criterion in NC's 2022 assessment methodology. The vertical lines bound 2016–2020. Dates retain the published calendar date; original times and timezone labels remain in thermal-screen.csv. The monthly panel shows observations by calendar month for each five-year window. The earlier window has no July readings; summer accounts for 7 of 31 records versus 12 of 26 later. Counts are descriptive and do not establish a temporal trend.
